description:
Provider → host (protocol 3): call a scope the provider's manifest
lists in its `needs` (`sql.read`: `args` = `{ sql, params? }`
→ rows). Answered with the scope's result, or `InvalidInput`
saying why not (one it doesn't need, one that isn't there).

key.description:
The idempotency key of the `invoke` it serves (`InvokeParams`), so
the host records the call with that run; none outside one.

op.description: The scope's operation, for one that has several.

title: HostCallParams
